Header.Title: INVALID — mismatched electrode model types (Partial parameterisation)
Header.Description: A 'Partial' parameterisation lets you omit sections, but the two electrodes must still describe the same kind of model. Here the Negative electrode is a Single-Particle-Model electrode (no 'Conductivity [S.m-1]', 'Porosity' or 'Transport efficiency'), while the Positive electrode is a full-model electrode (it includes 'Conductivity [S.m-1]', 'Porosity' and 'Transport efficiency'). BPX detects the mix and raises: 'Negative and positive electrodes must be of consistent model types'. Fix by making both electrodes SPM-style or both full-model-style.
